summary: Clean, targeted implementation of both Codex blockers. cmd_fill refuses any non-pending card and fills only blank fields, reusing the existing validators (ITEM_SKILLS/check_item/resolve_spec_reference/check_dag) and recording the change. The backfill zero-match branch drops the auto-predates and reports unresolved; cmd_mark_predates is the human-confirmed path (requires --reason, records an event). Symmetric, well-scoped, tested.
